verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Honeycomb capability for configuring trace or log sampling, or for choosing among retention tiers. The only related items are passing mentions: a 'retention period' in the context of SLO graphs, and plan event-volume limits. Neither shows a control a developer can use to manage data volume deliberately.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
